US.label: United States
US.narrative: Aggregate unemployment differential for top-quartile exposure remains statistically zero (Massenkoff & McCrory). Leading indicators are moving: job-finding rate for workers aged 22 to 25 in exposed occupations is down 14% vs 2022; Challenger counts 123.7K tech layoffs YTD and AI as the top cited layoff reason for a third straight month - 40% of May cuts, 22% of 2026 YTD.

Manufacturing automation continues but is largely robotics-driven, not generative-AI driven.
